units.source_text: 借着灯光，我大致溜了一圈晚报上的内容，

en.t: By the light, I glanced roughly over the contents of the evening paper,

units.source_text: 上面刊登的都是一些普通的事情，

en.t: and everything printed there was just ordinary news,

units.source_text: 诸如媾和事件啦，新婚夫妇啦，渎职事件啦，讣告新闻等等，

en.t: things like peace negotiations, newlyweds, misconduct cases, obituaries, and so on,

units.source_text: 没什么能让我提起精神劲儿来——

en.t: and nothing in it could lift my spirits at all.

units.source_text: 火车驶进隧道的时候，我觉得火车仿佛倒着开一样，

en.t: When the train entered the tunnel, I felt as though it were running backward,

units.source_text: 与此同时，盲目的看着这些无聊的消息。

en.t: while at the same time I stared blankly at those tedious items of news.

units.source_text: 可是，这期间，我不由的注意到端坐在我对面的姑娘，

en.t: But during that time, I could not help noticing the girl sitting primly opposite me,

units.source_text: 她脸上的神气简直就是这糟糕现实的人格化。

en.t: and the expression on her face was simply this wretched reality made human.
The train passing through the tunnel,

units.source_text: 以及充斥着平凡消息的晚报——

en.t: and the evening paper packed with commonplace news,

units.source_text: 这一切不就是最好的象征吗？

en.t: were these not the perfect symbol?

units.source_text: 不就是难以解释、无聊平凡的人生的象征吗？

en.t: Were they not a symbol of life itself, inexplicable, dull, and ordinary?

units.source_text: 这一切都让我觉得百无聊赖，心灰意冷，

en.t: All of this left me bored to death and utterly disheartened,

units.source_text: 我随手将没读完的晚报扔在一旁，

en.t: so I casually tossed the unread evening paper aside,
rested my head against the window frame again,

units.source_text: 像要死了一样闭上眼睛，懒懒的打盹儿。

en.t: closed my eyes as if I were dead, and dozed lazily.
